programme_definition.azami_role: diversity breadth: spatially extensive public-image and occurrence patterns
programme_definition.eazami_role: diversity depth: topology-conditioned histories, relative event depth and phylogeny-aware ecological correspondence
programme_definition.chapter2_goal: complete the reusable public-data layer by joining spatial and historical estimands without treating either as causal fitness evidence

primary_cross_scale_questions.required_comparison: estimate BIO12 and BIO15 under the same taxon, occurrence-source and phylogenetic universe, then fit univariate and joint models so amount and seasonality are not conflated

spatial_axes: surface downwelling shortwave radiation / solar radiation
historical_axes: phylogenetic signal or state history only where exact taxon-concept coverage is adequate
primary_cross_scale_questions.required_comparison: test solar-radiation correspondence in the broad Azami image panel first; do not manufacture a Japan38 colour history from sparse or unmatched taxon/voucher data

harmonization_rules.precipitation_amount: CHELSA BIO12 or an explicitly documented equivalent
harmonization_rules.solar_radiation: a pinned public climatology with units, baseline period and spatial resolution recorded
harmonization_rules.occurrence_quality: source-name guarded, coordinates quality-filtered, spatially thinned and deduplicated across sources
harmonization_rules.phylogeny: independent topology layers remain separate; incompatible marker systems are not pooled into one branch-length tree
model_sequence: within-versus-among taxon decomposition where repeated observations permit it
event-level correspondence only when transition placement and ancestral environment are estimable

claim_boundaries: Cross-scale agreement strengthens an adaptive hypothesis but does not establish adaptation or fitness benefit.
BIO12 and BIO15 are distinct ecological dimensions; agreement is not required and apparent disagreement must be tested in a joint model.
Present-day taxon niche centroids are not ancestral environments.
A spatial image association is not a historical transition test.
A phylogeny-aware association is not an event-specific causal mechanism.
Colour history is not inferred when exact concept-level colour coverage is inadequate.
No significant source tier is selected post hoc as the sole primary result.
